crossRefs.note: Don’t enter into the path of the wicked. Don’t walk in the way of evil men.
Avoid it, and don’t pass by it. Turn from it, and pass on.
Leave your simple ways, and live. Walk in the way of understanding.”
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
Blessed is the man who doesn’t walk in the counsel of the wicked, nor stand on the path of sinners, nor sit in the seat…
I have not sat with deceitful men, neither will I go in with hypocrites.
I hate the assembly of evildoers, and will not sit with the wicked.
Therefore “ ‘Come out from among them, and be separate,’ says the Lord. ‘Touch no unclean thing. I will receive you.
Don’t turn to the right hand nor to the left. Remove your foot from evil.
Remove your way far from her. Don’t come near the door of her house,
I have kept my feet from every evil way, that I might observe your word.
Yahweh says to this people, “Even so they have loved to wander. They have not restrained their feet. Therefore Yahweh…

translations.web: My son, don’t walk on the path with them. Keep your foot from their path,
translations.bsb: my son, do not walk the road with them or set foot upon their path.
translations.kjv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; refrain thy foot from their path:
translations.asv: My son, walk not thou in the way with them; Refrain thy foot from their path:
